name: testtopboch_route3min
description: 3-minute query for testtopboch_max: its own diagonal route across the map (headings [63, 119, 63, 131] deg, crossing the north-south reference legs at 30-60 deg), speed set by --speed (route 9.4 km: 50 m/s covers it in ~188 s), altitude 450-2000 m through all three layers (vertical rate <= 20 m/s), camera pitch -12..+18 deg and roll -8..+8 deg, yaw 0 (north-up like the heading-hold references). Route points are local map metres (x east, y north, map centre 0,0); the simulator refuses points whose footprint at the highest altitude plus the largest tilt would leave the map. Extra keys (description, phases) are ignored by the loader.

phases.label: acquire_1000
phases.note: cold start on the 1000 m layer (main), nadir

phases.label: climb_1000_2000
phases.note: handoff main -> 2 (2000 m); passes 1414 m, equal scale to both layers; pitch up to 12 deg, roll to 8 deg

phases.label: descend_2000_520
phases.note: handoffs 2 -> main (1414 m) -> 3 (707 m); pitch -10 deg then +18 deg, roll -8 deg

phases.label: climb_500_1000
phases.note: handoff 3 -> main; pitch -12 deg then nadir
